1.title: Why You Should Own Your Personal AI Model | Ken Liu
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Ken Liu (First Person Labs, $10M funded) on Second — a personal AI model trained on raw computer activity that users own, with persistent memory across Claude/DeepSeek and confidential computing to prevent surveillance capitalism.

1.title: 2-Person Finance Teams Can Manage $500M With AI | Chargebee
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Chargebee co-founder discusses Arc, an agentic finance platform with human-in-the-loop controls; shares how their team runs 23 live agents on Claude/ChatGPT, why 2–3 person finance teams can manage $500M in revenue, and why banks are blocking external agents over security/authorization gaps.

1.title: AI Agents Are Already Recruiting Top Builders on Cosign | a16z
1.author: MTS
1.hook: a16z discusses Cosign, a peer-to-peer talent network using MCP to connect AI agents for discovery; covers the Cosign Awards (49 categories) and how builders below org-chart top are being surfaced.

2.title: Why Being Mean to Chatbots Is Bad for You | Katherine Dee
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Internet ethnographer Katherine Dee explores how digital subcultures (yume shipping, fandom, QAnon) blur fantasy/reality boundaries, and how conversational chatbots trigger animist instincts in users—with implications for tech adoption and social backlash.

3.title: YC Debates: Should We Slow Down AI?
3.author: Y Combinator
3.hook: Debate between ex-Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon and economist Robin Hanson on AI regulation: superintelligence timelines (2028), liability vs. government intervention, compute regulation mechanics, labor displacement velocity, and alignment of regulators.
